leadText:
Sonny (Japanese: ソノタ Sonota) is a character of the day who appeared in Cruisin' for a Losin. He is a Pokémon Coordinator.

Sonny entered the R1 Rubello Town Pokémon Contest with his . After advancing through the Appeals Round, he faced off against Drew in the first match of the Battle Round. Sonny hoped that he would defeat the Coordinator and take home the Rubello Town Ribbon. Unfortunately, Drew and his proved to be stronger than he had hoped, and Sonny and his Girafarig were defeated.
